scientific_question: At the successful generated-QK/dense-V/dense-O endpoint, is the held-out task direction of the joint per-head value/output operator K_h = O_h V_h materially more stable and useful than the K_h direction induced by the actual separate dense-Muon V and O factor updates?

qk_plus_v_endpoint.fact: Generated V costs only 0.0290 CE relative to QK-only and remains within +0.0038 CE of the fair blockwise-dense control.

trajectory_manifold.fact: The V/O quotient trajectory was not globally simpler than its factors, and residual head contribution was not simpler than the value/output kernel. A task-direction gate is therefore required before proposing a joint operator chart.

cproj_rejection.fact: Tenfold fixed-chart capacity and activation-metric preconditioning failed; the trained c_proj chart was indistinguishable from an equal-coordinate random chart.

protocol.runtime_policy: zero-update diagnostic expected under five minutes; foreground-poll directly and do not attach a watchdog
protocol.operator_convention: PyTorch F.linear weights: V_h is [head_dim,d], O_h is [d,head_dim], K_h=O_h@V_h is [d,d], and the residual contribution is S_h@K_h.T where S_h=A_h@X_value.
protocol.direct_direction: For each layer/head/window accumulate G_K=R.T@S_h and form the per-head Muon polar direction U_K.
protocol.factor_direction: Accumulate the actual full dense V and O gradients, apply the existing full-matrix Muon transform separately, then linearize K_h: U_factor=U_O[:,h]@V_h + O_h@U_V[h,:].
primary_metrics: fit direct-direction cosine with the disjoint holdout raw task gradient
fit factor-induced-direction cosine with the disjoint holdout raw task gradient
factor-induced line recovery of the direct functional direction

preregistered_gate.pass_action: Design one nonlearned joint V/O functional generator with explicit materialization and trainable-parameter accounting. Preregister its exact architecture and require a fresh exact-config >=20% MFU gate before any training.
preregistered_gate.fail_action: Retain generated QK+V with dense c_proj as the honest attention-compression endpoint; do not train a direct V/O operator chart from this evidence.

exclusions: retained dense gradients or optimizer state after scoring
automatic architecture construction, MFU preflight, or training
